_doc: Per-basin Polluted River Stretch (PRS) sources. To onboard a new river's PRS, add a basin entry here and run `python3 scripts/build_prs.py <basinId>` - no code change. Each year entry: the source GPKG + layer (optionally one fid), its survey year, and the CPCB/NGT priority band (I = worst). Layers carrying an authoritative distance attribute (the canonical 2025 layer's 'Distance (In Km)') declare it via distanceAttr; the build cross-checks geometry against it. NOTE (post-#290): the Arkavathi builds from Paani's canonical PRS_Stretches_Since_1993 package, NOT the older standalone Arkavathi_PRS_Stretch_*.gpkg files - those carry a shorter, superseded 2025 line, and the 2018/2020 editions are byte-identical geometry (there is no distinct 2020 edition; the epoch is 2018). Output goes to public/data/basins/<basinId>/prs.geojson and is consumed by the generic `prs` layer + PRSPanel.
